books.title: Against the Grain
books.author: J.-K. Huysmans
books.summary: Ailing, neurotic, and bored with the world, a French nobleman retreats to a secluded cottage in the countryside to create an artificial paradise for himself.

books.title: The Old Man in the Corner
books.author: Baroness Orczy
books.summary: An elderly man explains to a woman reporter how he solved crimes that stumped the local police.

books.title: Confessions of an English Opium-Eater
books.author: Thomas De Quincey
books.summary: A portrait of the life of a drug addict in Georgian-era London.

books.title: Eminent Victorians
books.author: Lytton Strachey
books.summary: Four witty and biting biographies of Victorians that take aim at the moral superiority of their subject’s time.

books.title: Kidnapped
books.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
books.summary: After his parents die, a young Scottish man travels to see his only remaining relative, expecting to be welcomed, but instead finds his life and liberty in grave danger.

books.title: The Conscious Lovers
books.author: Richard Steele
books.summary: A rich young man tries to avoid the marriage his father has arranged.

books.title: Edward II
books.author: Christopher Marlowe
books.summary: Outraged by the favoritism shown by King Edward II to a close confidant, his court plots against him.

books.title: The Roots of the Mountains
books.author: William Morris
books.summary: The peoples of the dales and woods must unite to defeat a foe intent on enslaving them.

books.title: The Well of Loneliness
books.author: Radclyffe Hall
books.summary: A young woman struggles to understand and accept herself, and particularly her love of other women, in a society that rejects her unconventional behavior as unfeminine and even unnatural.

books.title: The Portent
books.author: George MacDonald
books.summary: A young Scottish tutor, gifted with a supernatural sense, discovers a haunting connection to a somnambulant noblewoman while residing at a remote English estate.

books.title: South!
books.author: Ernest Shackleton
books.summary: A British expedition sets off to cross Antarctica, but when their ship is wrecked they have to face a long struggle for survival.

books.title: Craig Kennedy Stories
books.author: Arthur B. Reeve
books.summary: A collection of short stories starring Craig Kennedy, scientific detective.

books.title: My Disillusionment in Russia
books.author: Emma Goldman
books.summary: Emma Goldman recounts her experiences living in the early Soviet Union.

books.title: Pragmatism
books.author: William James
books.summary: James introduces the philosophy of pragmatism and applies it to some metaphysical problems.

books.title: Lyrical Ballads
books.author: William Wordsworth
books.summary: A collection of pastoral poems that is considered the defining text for the beginning of Romantic-era literature.

books.title: The Devil’s Dictionary
books.author: Ambrose Bierce
books.summary: A witty, sharp collection of sardonic word definitions from the 1800s and early 1900s that provide a snapshot into the irreverent humor of early American culture.

books.title: Key Out of Time
books.author: Andre Norton
books.summary: While searching a distant world of shallow seas and archipelagos for traces of a galactic civilization, a group of explorers get stranded in the past and face a dangerous enemy.

books.title: Short Fiction
books.author: Vsevolod Garshin
books.summary: A collection of Garshin’s translated short stories and novellas ordered by date of publication.

books.title: Religion and the Rise of Capitalism
books.author: R. H. Tawney
books.summary: A tracing of the development of religious thought from the Middle Ages to the dawn of the Industrial Revolution.

books.title: Jack Keefe Stories
books.author: Ring Lardner
books.summary: A boastful, nearly illiterate major league pitcher writes a series of letters home detailing the goings-on in his life and career.
